issues.description: The UML in the problem statement shows Animal.messageOnFeed() as a public abstract method (+ messageOnFeed():String), but the reference solution declares it as protected (protected abstract String messageOnFeed()). This visibility mismatch between the specification and the solution may confuse students about the intended access level for the abstract method and could cause tests or grading scripts that expect a public abstract method to fail or produce misleading feedback.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either change the solution to declare the abstract method as public (public abstract String messageOnFeed();) to match the UML/specification, or update the problem statement/UML to indicate that messageOnFeed() is protected. The recommended fix is to declare messageOnFeed() as public abstract in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java so it matches the UML and student expectations.
